fingerprint.text: ሁለት ሺህ አሥራ ሁለት ዓመተ ምሕረት። እኩለ ቀን ላይ ከአንኮበር ተነሳሁ። አንድ የጀርባ ቦርሳ ብቻ ይዤ። አንድ ጓደኛዬ ሸኘኝ።
fingerprint.subtitle: It was 2012 in the Ethiopian calendar. At midday I left Ankober. Just one backpack. A friend saw me off.

meta.literal: Two thousand twelve, Year of Mercy. At midday I set out from Ankober. Carrying only one backpack. A friend of mine saw me off.

fingerprint.text: በአውቶቡሱ መስኮት በኩል ተቀምጬ ነበር። ውጪው ደንና ተራራ ነው። እይታው ድንቅ ነበር።
fingerprint.subtitle: I sat by the window of the bus. Outside, forest and mountains. The view was amazing.

meta.literal: I was sitting by the window of the bus. Outside is forest and mountain. The view was wonderful.

fingerprint.text: ላምበረት የደረስኩት ከመሸ በኋላ ነው። ጓደኛዬ እዚያው ጠበቀኝ። ሰው፣ መብራት፣ መኪና፤ ሁሉም በአንድ ጊዜ።
fingerprint.subtitle: I reached Lamberet after dark. My friend was there, waiting for me. People, lights, cars: everything at once.

meta.literal: It was after dark that I reached Lamberet. My friend waited for me right there. People, lights, cars; all at once.

fingerprint.text: ብዙ ሰው። ብዙ ጫጫታ። በብርሃን የተሞላች ከተማ።
fingerprint.subtitle: So many people. So much sound. A city full of light.

meta.literal: Many people. Much noise. A city filled with light.

fingerprint.text: አውቶቡስ ተራ ስንደርስ ደላሎች ከበቡን። «አልጋ ትፈልጋላችሁ?» «አልጋ?» ከየአቅጣጫው። ግራ ገባን። በመጨረሻ አንዱን መረጥን።
fingerprint.subtitle: At Autobus Tera the brokers closed in on us. "Do you want a bed?" "A bed?" From every side. We were lost. In the end we picked one.

meta.literal: When we arrived at Autobus Tera, brokers surrounded us. "Do you want a bed?" "A bed?" From every direction. We were confused. In the end we chose one.

fingerprint.text: ክፍሉ ባለ አንድ አልጋ ነበር። በጣም ጥሩ አይደለም፣ መጥፎም አይደለም። ንጹሕ ነበር።
fingerprint.subtitle: The room had one bed. Not very good, not bad. It was clean.

meta.literal: The room was a one-bed room. Not very good, and not bad either. It was clean.

fingerprint.text: ጠዋት ረጅም ሰልፍ ተሰልፈን ትኬት ቆረጥን።
fingerprint.subtitle: In the morning we stood in a long queue and got the ticket.

meta.literal: In the morning we stood in a long line and bought tickets.

fingerprint.text: ዛሬ ያንን ልጅ ማናገር ብችል እንዲህ እለው ነበር፦ አትፍራ። በሕይወት ውስጥ ብዙ የምትማረው ነገር አለ።
fingerprint.subtitle: If I could speak to that boy now, I would tell him: do not be scared. There is a lot to learn in life.

meta.literal: If I could speak to that child today, I would tell him this: Don't be afraid. There are many things you will learn in life.

fingerprint.text: እስከ ደብረ ብርሃን መንገዱ ፒስታ ነበር። ከዚያ በኋላ አስፋልት።
fingerprint.subtitle: The road was gravel as far as Debre Birhan. After that, asphalt.

meta.literal: Up to Debre Birhan the road was gravel (unpaved). After that, asphalt.

fingerprint.text: ያ ሌሊት ግራ አጋባኝ። ዛሬ ግን ከቤቱ ለሚወጣ ሁሉ አንድ ነገር እላለሁ፦ የመጀመሪያው ሌሊት ሁሌም ግራ ያጋባል። አትሽሽ። አጣጥመው።
fingerprint.subtitle: That night confused me. Today I tell everyone who leaves home one thing: the first night is always confusing. Do not run from it. Savour it.

meta.literal: That night confused me. But today I say one thing to everyone who leaves home: the first night always confuses. Do not flee. Savour it.
In 2019 I left Ankober with one suitcase. A few clothes. A few books.
From Lamberet, my friend and I took a taxi and crossed Addis Ababa. He knows the city. I did not know it.
differences: 'he knows the city' (present) becomes 'he knew the city' (past)

meta.literal: We got off at Autobus Tera. It was there that the fear came.
Many people. Much noise. A city filled with light.
Holding my suitcase tightly, I followed him through the crowd, as we looked for a place to stay near the bus station.
In the morning a bus takes me to Bahir Dar, to the university.
differences: Tense changed: the spoken line uses the present/future imperfective ('takes' or 'will take me'), but the subtitle's 'would take me' makes it a past habit or a conditional.

meta.literal: That night sleep did not take me.
If I could speak to that child today, I would tell him this: Don't be afraid. There are many things you will learn in life.
It was around midday when I set out from Ankober. Carrying only one backpack. A friend of mine had come to see me off.
Up to Debre Birhan the road was gravel (unpaved). After that, asphalt.
I was sitting by the window of the bus. Outside is forest and mountain. The view was wonderful.
When I reached Lamberet, it had become evening. My friend was waiting for me. There were many people; building lights, many cars.
When we arrived at Autobus Tera, brokers surrounded us. "Do you want a bed?" They were many. We were confused. We chose one.
The room was a one-bed room. Not very good, and not bad either. It was clean.
In the morning we stood in a long line and bought tickets.
If I met that boy today, I would tell him only one thing: live it.
Two thousand twelve, Year of Mercy. At midday I set out from Ankober. Carrying only one backpack. A friend of mine saw me off.
When I reach Lamberet, it has already become night. My friend is waiting for me right there. People, lights, cars; all at once.
differences: The friend's waiting is in the present tense ('is waiting for me') in the spoken line, but the subtitle puts it in the past ('was there, waiting').

meta.literal: When we arrived at Autobus Tera, brokers surrounded us. "Do you want a bed?" "A bed?" From every direction. We were confused. In the end we chose one.
That night confused me. But today I say one thing to everyone who leaves home: the first night always confuses. Do not flee. Savour it.
It was after dark that I reached Lamberet. My friend waited for me right there. People, lights, cars; all at once.
